tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (497)gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha dgongs gter them med dang bcas pa'i dbang gi 'grigs rim byin rlabs gter mdzod bzhugs/ /(498)na mo gu ru bhyaḥmacha
(497)gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha dgongs gter them med dang bcas pa'i dbang gi 'grigs rim byin rlabs gter mdzod bzhugs/ /(498)na mo gu ru bhyaḥmacha

tei:div.tei:p: (497) gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha dgongs gter them med dang bcas pa'i dbang gi 'grigs rim byin rlabs gter mdzod bzhugs// (498)na mo gu ru bhyaḥ mchog tu mi 'gyur zab gsal mkhar// bde ba chen po'i snang byed bdag /rdul bral rdo rje'i zer mdangs 'khrugs// gter chen bla ma gang des skyongs/ bka' gter 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las// zab rgu'i gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i skyes// nges don snying po'i nying khu mchog smin grol gud rtsi'i sgo 'phar dbye/ 'dir smin byed rnams dkyus gcig tu 'bogs pa la gsum/ don gyi go rim/ chos sde'i go rim/ lag len 'debs tshul lo// dad po la gnyis/ rgyud sde'i skor la// lus dkyil gyi dam pa rigs brgya'i gzungs dbang*/ sgrub thabs kyi kun bzang dbang*/ bde mchog phyi sgrub/ nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub/ bde mchog dmar po'i dbang*/ rgyud bdag zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang*/ drag po rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ ༈ gnyis pa sgrub sde la byin rlabs bla ma'i sgrub pa la/ lus dkyil gyi bla ma rdo rje can gyi gzungs dbang*/ rnga yab gling pa'i gzungs dbang*/ lha lnga'i pad 'byung me tog ma'i gzungs dbang*/rigs lnga'i pad 'byung sku gsum gzungs dbang*// o rgyan zhi khro sde brgyad gzungs dbang*// porṇaiya'i (?)thod phreng rigs lnga'i gzungs dbang*/ sgrub thabs pad 'byung (499)dbang sgrub thabs dgongs 'dus dbang*/ de'i rang gzhung padma rgyal po'i dbang*/ gu ru zhi ba rang gzhung rtsa dbang4*/ o rgyan sgrub thabs bsdus pa'i gzungs dbang4*/ gu ru mtshan brgyad gzungs dbang*/ gu ru rin po che'i dbang zab mo/ o rgyan sgrub pa dkrug yig can gyi gzungs dbang*/ ming gi mngon rtogs las/ rab byung can/ thub tshab dmar/ pad steng bzhugs/ skyabs sbyin mdzad// zog lpags can/ dkar po mche(?)/ padma saṃ bha rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ blo ldan shar 'gyur/ mkhas pa/

sngags pa/ ḍa ru 'khrol/ bhandha 'dzin/ gos sngon can/ blo ldan sngo/ rigs lnga mkhas/ pad zlar bzhugs/ nyi dbu can/ me gdan dkar/ blo ldan mchog sred rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ sbrul rgyan can/ seng lpags can/ so 'khrol can/ sdang mig can/ rngams sgra can/ dgra non can/ mu stegs bsgral/ bstan pa gso/ seng ge sgra sgrogs rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ rgyal po che/ gzi brjid can/ dmar chen/ pad bzhugs/ zla bzhugs/ padma rgyal po rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ sku mdog ser/ dbang po'i gdan/ rdo rje gdan/ nyi ma mkhyen/ sprul byed/ mgon byed/ rdo rje 'dzin/ ser 'khyug mdzod can/ rdo rje bsnams/ shākya seng (500)ge rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ gur drag gi rnga yab gling pa'i gzungs dbang*/ o rgyan zab ston gzungs dbang*/ tshe dpag rgyud dgongs 'dus gzungs dbang*/ dgongs 'dus yum gzungs dbang*/ u pa rā dza las rtsa ba bcu gnyis kyi nyi ma 'od zer gzungs dbang*/ rig 'dzin chen po'i gzungs dbang*/ blo ldan mchog sred gzungs dbang*/ dgongs 'dus phur mjug gzungs dbang*/ (

theg med mtshan brgyad gcig ) dril/ (padma rgyal po gnyis gzungs dbang*/ bla ma rdo rje nas 'di yan gzungs dbang gcig/ ༈ bla ma drag po'i skor la/ sgrub thabs gur drag dbang*/ rdo rje gro lod dbang*// rdo rje rang gzhung drag nag dbang 7/ gu ru zhi ba'i/ rdo rje gro lod gzungs dbang*/ ming gi mngon rtogs kyi lha mchog rang gzhung dam pa'i dbang bskur bar chad kun8 sel/ de'i yid bzhin nor bu'i 'jigs tshogs thar pa'i dbang*/ gro lod 'bir byed*/ khon byed/ stag zhon// bya zhon/ seng zhon/ gsod gcod/ grus 'gong*/ chu rtsal/ nyi 'dzin/ zla 'dzin/ skar 'dzin/ rdo rje gro lod rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ dhe ru gro lod gzungs dbang*/ gur drag gi phyi sgrub zhal gsum phyag drug nang sgrub zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ gsang sgrub zhal gcig phyag gnyis// yang gsang phyag gnyis yum dmar 'khril ba'i dbang*/ drag mthing gzungs dbang*/ gro lod (501)gzungs dbang*/ gur drag phur mjug/ gro lod phur mjug gzungs dbang*/ sgrol ma'i rdo rje gro lod gzungs dbang*/11 dgongs gter drag mthing dbang 12/ gro lod dbang 13/ theg med gur drag gzungs dbang*/ ༈ bla sgrub 'thor bu'i skor la/ tshe dpag ḍom bhi pa'i gzungs dbang*/ porṇaiya'i (?)birba pa'i gzungs dbang*/ mi tra dzo ka'i gzungs dbang*/ sgye'u'i bla ma rgya gar rgyal gzungs dbang*/ gu ru zhi ba'i paṇa chen bi ma la'i gzungs dbang*/ pha dam pa rgya gar gzungs dbang*/ ratna gling pa'i phyi sgrub nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub gzungs dbang*/ upa rā dza'i rtsa ba bcu gnyis pa'i/ ḍoṃ bhi pa/ dam pa sangs rgyas gzungs dbang 14/ ༈ yi dam spyir sgrub pa'i skor la/ sgrub thabs bka' brgyad dbang 15/ bde mchog phyi sgrub/ nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub/ bde mchog dmar po'i rang gzhung dbang16*/ bka' brgyad phur mjug gi gzungs dbang17*/ u pa rā dza'i dbang 18*/ dgongs gter bka' brgyad dbang 19bcas/

༈ yi dam bye brag pa'i 'jam dpal zhi sgrub la/ 'jam dbyangs phyag rtags spra ma'i dbang*/ 'jam dpal rigs drug dbang 20/ them med 'jam dkar gzungs dbang*/ ༈ 'jam dpal drag sgrub la/ gnam lcags pha lam gzungs dbang*/ sgrub thabs khro chu/ 'jigs byed/ gshed dmar// gshed nag 'jam (502) pa'i rdo rje'i dbang 21/ ming gi mngon rtogs kyi/ king kang dmar byed/ gso byed/ 'khor bye/ tho can/ 'gugs byed/ brdung byed/ me mdog dgra bzlog 'big nad/ shi hur can/ gcod pa/ tog ca/ ma ca/ ha ri te/ king kang smug bcas gzungs dbang*/ gur drag rdo rje 'jigs byed gzungs dbang*/ tshe bdag nag po'i gzungs dbang*/ ye shes 'jigs byed gzungs dbang*/ 'jam dpal nā ga raksha'i gzungs dbang*/ king kang phur mjug khro chu phur mjug gzungs dbang*/ ma ning 'char ka'i gzungs dbang 22/ dgongs gter khro chu pha khol lugs bka' gtad23/ them med rdo rje gnam lcags zhun ma/ gshin rje 'ur len/ king dmar/ king nag bheta tsa li/ ro lang nag po/ gsod byed nag po/ 'char ka nag po/ sha gsum/ tshe brlag rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ ༈ padma gsung zhi sgrub tshe dpag med la/ tshe dbang rgyas pa24/ 'bring po 25/ bsdus pa/ phyi/ nang*/ gsang ba/ yang gsang gzungs dbang*/ tshe dpag smyug rgod gzungs dbang rigs lnga'i tshe sgrub smyug rgod gzungs dbang*/ rno (?)bkra'i tshe dbang*/ mgon po tshe dpag med kyi gzungs dbang 27/ sgrub thabs tshe dpag dbang28*/ dgongs gter tshe dpag dkar po'i dbang 39/ dmar po'i dbang 30/ ༈ 'od dpag med pa'i skor la/ tshe dpag bde chen zhing dbang*/ snang mtha' tshe sgrub dbang 31/ 'od dpag med gzungs dbang 32/ snang mtha'i dbang 33/ sgrub thabs snang mtha'i 34(503)dbang*/ ༈ zhi ba thugs rje chen po'i dbang la/ tshe dpag rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshe sgrub gzungs dbang*/ thugs chen tshe sgrub gzungs dbang*/ lus dkyil gzungs dbang*/ rten sgrub gzungs dbang*/

phyag stong rgyas pa/ 'bring po/ bsdus pa'i gzungs dbang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gzungs dbang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshe sgrub gzungs dbang*/ padma gtsug tor gzungs dbang*/ lha lnga'i rtsa dbang*/ snang mtha' snang*/ thugs rje las byang ltar dbang*/ lha mang dbang*/ pad 'byung me tog ma'i gzungs dbang*/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gzungs dbang*/ dam can mgar dmar gzungs dbang*/ rigs lnga'i 'gro 'dul bum dbang*/ rgyal rgyam nor dbang*/ don zhags zhags pa'i dbang*/ 'khor chen smad g.yogs dbang 36// porṇaiya'i(?) bod dkar can gyi gzungs dbang lha dgu'i dbang 37/ gsang 'dus 'jin rten dbang phyug padma'i rigs/ rin chen rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs// las kyi rigs/ rno (?)bkra'i dbang 38/ thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul gzungs dbang*/ uṣṇi'i gzungs dbang*/ lha/ lha min/ mi*/ byol song*/ yi dwags/ dmyal ba'i thub pa rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ thugs rje chen po sgye'u pa'i dbang 39chen/ sgrub thabs thugs rje chen po'i dbang 40/ gu ru zhi ba'i yid =(504)bzhin 'khor lo'i gzungs dbang*/ rgya mtsho lha lnga'i gzungs dbang*/ rgya mtsho lha bzhi'i gzungs dbang*/ seng ge sgra'i gzungs dbang*/ rigs gsum gcig dril gzungs dbang*/ u pa rā dza'i sku bzhi gcig dril/ rtsa ba bcu gnyis thugs rje chen po phyag gnyis pa/ phyag bzhi pa'i gzungs dbang 41/ dgongs gter thugs chen bzhengs sku'i dbang 42/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dbang 43/ thugs chen nag po'i dbang 44/ don zhags dbang 45/ chu shel mdog gi dbang 46/ ༈ drag po rta mgrin gyi skor la/ lus dkyil rta mgrin lha lnga'i gzungs dbang*/ sgrub thabs rta mgrin dbang 46/ u pa rā dza'i rtsa ba bcu gnyis nang yi dam rta mgrin gzungs dbang*/ rgyud bdag rta mgrin bar chad kun sel gzungs dbang*/ rta mgrin phur mjug gzungs dbang*/ dgongs gter rta mgrin ljang gu'i dbang 49/ ༈ thugs rigs yang dag gi skor la/

dgongs gter yang dag dbu dgu'i dbang 50/ sgrub thabs phyag na rdo rje'i dbang 51/ ming gi mngon rdzogs mtha' yas/ 'bar ma nam mkha'i mdog lag gnas/ 'phang brgyad/ seng ge'i sgra/ dmigs pa/ lugs pa/ rgyud pa 'gred/ aṃ tsug byed rtsa dbang 52/ sangs rgyas dbur bzhugs/ bla ma can/ ag tshom can/ me sgra/ ldan/ phyag na rdo rje rnams kyis gzungs (505)dbang*/ dhe ru'i phyag rdor gzungs dbang*/ ro za'i rdo rje sgeg pa'i gzungs dbang 53/ them med 'jigs med rdo rje'i gzungs dbang*/ dgongs gter phyag rdor u tsa ya'i dbang 54/ ༈ bdud rtsi sman gyi skor la/ tshe dpag chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i gzungs dbang*/ sgrub thabs che mchog dbang 55/ rigs lnga'i nad pa byin rlabs shog bkra ma56/ gu ru zhi ba'i sman bla'i gzungs dbang 56/ dgongs gter sman 58bla'i dbang*/ ༈ phur pa phrin las kyi skor la/ sgrub thabs rdo rje phur pa'i dbang 59/ bde mchog rdo rje gzhon nu'i gzungs dbang*/ rdo rje gzhon nu phur mjug can gyi gzungs dbang 60/ ༈ ma mo rbod gtong gi skor la/ sgrub thabs seng gdong dbang 61/ seng gdong phur mjug gzungs dbang*/ phag mo'i seng gdong gzungs dbang*/ dgongs gter seng gdong ma'i gzungs dbang*/ ༈ 'jig rten mchod bstod skor la/ lus dkyil snyigs dus skyobs pa'i lha lnga*/ rdo rje rgod/ me 'bar rdo rje/ rdo rje dug ri/ rdo rje kha dmar/ nag po glang bdud rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ porṇaiya'i(?) rtsa du mched dgu a dkar tsa du/ tsa du ya sngon/ than bdag sreg gcod/ kun 'dus/ na kṣa/ li ha/ sparab/ ma ra rnams kyi bka' btad 63/ gur drag gi (506)dmag las rgyal/ dgra las rgyal/ tshong las rgyal/ nad las rgyal/ bgegs las rgyal rnams kyi gzungs 64dbang*/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi chos skor la/ gur drag gi log tra'i/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang*/ drag po/ ro za'i sde brgyad srog dbang*/ ༈ mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i skor la/

sgrub thabs mtsho rgyal dbang*/ rdo rje phag mo'i dbang*/ khros ma nag mo'i dbang*/ kun tu bzang mo'i dbang*/ yi ge drug ma'i dbang*/ sgrol dkar dbang*/ sgrol ljang dbang*/ khro gnyer can dbang 67/ u pa rā dza'i rtsa ba bcu gnyis las rdo rje phag mo'i gzungs dbang*/ khro ma phur mjug gzungs dbang*/ phagam̐ mom̐'i spros bcas dbang 68/ nad gdon sel ba'i dbang 69/ rim srung tsaka li bzhi pa70/ phag mo spros bral dbang 71/ khros ma'i gzungs dbang*/ lab sgron gzungs dbang*/ sgrolam̐ mam̐ sngon mo'i dbang*/ dkar mo'i dbang 72/ las hur zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang*/ drag po'i dbang 73/ rdo rje g.yu drag ratna/ khroṃ drag padma nag drag/ karma 'grog chen rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ shing gi lha mo/ rlung*/ me/ dgra bzlog sa/ lcags/ nam mkha'/ chu/ phyogs kyi lha mo rnams kyi gzungs dbang 74/ dgongs gter phag mo dbu bcad dbang 75/ (507)khros ma lha lnga'i dbang 76/ ༈ chos skyong skor la/ tshe dpag bka' srung gsum gyi dbang 77/ zhal bzhi pa'i gzungs dbang*/ lus dkyil jo bo tshogs bdag gzungs dbang*/ mdung 'dzin rtsa dbang 78/ brag mgon gzungs dbang*/ sgrub thabs/ ma ning gi dbang*/ kṣe tra pa la'i dbang*/ phyag gzhi pa'i dbang*/ phyag drug pa'i dbang*/ nor lha shan pa'i dbang*/ ber brtsegs dbang*/ mgar dmar dbang*/ mgar nag dbang 79/ gu ru zhi ba'i jo bo tshogs bdag bka' gtad/ zhing skyong dkar po'i bka' gtad/ gter srung mkhar nag bka' gtad/ dam can mgar ba'i bka' gtad/ gter srung mkha' ri lcam dral bka' gtad/ rma chen spom ra'i bka' gtad/ ming gi mngon rtogs/ las mkhan se ba khra 'thung bka' gtad/ dhe ru pa'i gzungs dbang*/ dhe ru pa'i srog dbang*/ chos skyong dbang phyug ngan chen/ gza' bdud/ smyo kha/ shan pa/ ber rtse/ mgar nag mgar dmar/ g.yu sgron/ ngan ne rnams kyi bka' gtad/ las mgon yag pa/ nag po chen po/ 'jigs byed can/ bya mchu can/ gshog pa can/ 'od zer can/

ngo khro can/ mig sdang can/ rgyu zhags can/ sbrul zhags can/ thod rlon can/ (508)thod skam can/ bya rog gdong rnams kyi bka' gtad/ bde mchog dur bdag yab yum bka' gtad/ gur drag rdo rje 'bar lcam dral bka' gtad// rdo rje bdud 'dul bka' gtad// zhing skyong seng gdong yab yum bka' gtad/ rol pa rkya bdun bka' gtad/ sog ma med kyi bka' gtad// jag pa me len bka' gtad/ kong btsun de mo'i bka' gtad/ ro za'i gur mgon gzungs dbang*/ u pa rā dza'i rtsa ba bcu gnyis lha sman g.yu sgron/ jo bo tshogs bdag brag lha mgon po rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ ye ka dza tri'i gzungs dbang*/ drang srong phur mjug re ti phur mjug gzungs dbang*/ phag mo'i dud sol rma bya'i dbu can gzungs dbang*/ dud sol lha mo'i gzungs dbang*/ rang byung rgyal po'i gzungs dbang*/ re ma ti'i gzungs dbang*/ sngags kyi srung ma'i gzungs dbang*/ dmag zor rgyal mo'i gzungs dbang*/ khri sman si li'i gzungs dbang*/ dud sol lha mo'i gzungs dbang*/ stag sman ser ldem gzungs dbang*/ dngos grub zhal ma'i gzungs dbang*/ ba lam dril sna'i gzungs dbang*/ gtum mo 'jigs byed gzungs dbang*/ lha mo spyang bzhon gzungs dbang*/ yi dwags kha'i gzungs dbang*/ g.yu sgron brtan ma'i (509)gzungs dbang*/ srin mo g.yag gdong gzungs dbang*/ lha mo kho le'i gzungs dbang*/ tshe ring mched lnga'i bka' gtad// g.yu sgron phyi sgrub dkar/ nang sgrub ser/ gsangasgrub dmar/ yang gsang ljang/ dkar sgrub/ nag sgrub rnams kyi bka' gtad/ a gho ra'i bka' gtad/ sgrol ma'i thang nag dpal mo'i gzungs dbang*/ las hur stag srin zor gdong*/ baṃ srin dred gdong*/ kong srin ba lang gdong*/ 'brog srin chu srin gdong rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ a phyi chos sgron ma'i gzungs dbang*/ ma ning sku mgon dkar po gsung mgon dmar po/ thugs mgon mthing ga/ yon tan mgon ser/

phrin las mgon ljang rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ ma ning mgon po nag po'i gzungs dbang*/ thub bdag glog phreng gzungs dbang/ ma ning srong bdud gzungs dbang*/ ma mgon sde brgyad gzungs dbang*/ dpal mgon ma ning gzungs dbang*/ tra kshad gzungs dbang*/ gter mgon yab yum gzungs dbang*/ rtsa 'jib ma'i gzungs dbang*/ ber nag mgon po sum sbrag gi dbang 80/ ber nag yab yum gzungs dbang*/ mgon dkar gzungs dbang*/ phyag drug pa'i gzungs dbang*/ dge bsnyen smyo kha'i bka' gtad// sprag btsan bka' (510)gtad/ gnod sbyin phyi sgrub shan pa dmar nag nang sgrub chos skyong ber brtsegs/ gsang sgrub btsan mgon yam shud/ nor sgrub gnod sbyin dmar nag shan pa dmar nag shan pa las mkhan/ btsan mgon ber brtsegs rnams kyi bka' gtad sgrom rgya ma81/ hab sha'i rang gi bka' gtad82/ ra hu la'i bka' gtad/ mgar nag gi bka' gtad/ ngan ne shin tu zhi ba/ zhi ba/ khros pa/ shin tu khros pa'i bka' gtad/ dam can ral thod can bka' gtad/ srin mgon rigs lnga'i rang gi bka' gtad83/ ma ning gter srung ngom rgyal bka' gtad/ dgongs gter legs ldan dbang 84/ bya zhon dbang 85/ phyag drug rigs lnga'i gzungs dbang 86/ trag shad dbang 87/ re ti mched gsum dbang 88/ ko ri brgyad rang gtad89/ dug shing lha mo'i bka' gtad90/ thang lha'i bka' gtad91/ them med spu gri mched gsum/ dam can mgar dmar/ kṣe tra pa la/ gza'/ lha mo spyang bzhon/ bsam yas chos skyong bcas kyi bka' gtad/ ༈ bsnyen sgrub spyi gces skor la/ gur drag bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i gzungs dbang*/ kun thub rgyal mo'i gzungs dbang 92/ ༈ las sna tshogs pa la gnyis spyi dang bye brag go// dang po ni/ ma ning ha sa garbha'i rang gi gtad/ dgongs gter sna tshogs yum gzungs 93dbang*/ lha mo rkang thang rang gtad 94/ gnyis pa bye brag la/ lnga/ srung ba/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang*/ drag po'i/ dang po la gsum las/ dang po/

yul 'khor srung ba la/ dzaṃ la'i yul 'khor srung*/ 'phags skyes po/ spyan mi bzang*/ rnam thos sras kyi gzungs dbang 95/ ༈ ser ba srung ba la/ rdo rje mchu'i gzungs dbang*/96 ༈ dgra rkun srung ba la/ sgrol ma'i 'od zer can gzungs dbang*/101 dgongs gter 'od zer can gyi dbang*/ gnyis pa zhi ba la lnga las/ dang po nad zhi ba la/ tshe dpag lo gyon dbang*/ rno bkra'i shi lo ma'i dbang*/ sgrub thabs lo gyon dbang*/ ༈ gdon zhi ba la/ gur drag ye shes khyung khra'i gzungs dbang*/ sdig pa'i gzungs dbang*/ ro za'i gdon krol102/ khyung dmar me phreng thog rgod can rtsa dbang 103/ dgongs gter rab tu 'jigs pa'i gzungs dbang 104/ khyung khra'i dbang 105/ ༈ grib zhi ba'i skor la/ spe porṇaiya'i(?) rnam 'joms gzungs dbang*/ phag mo'i sme brtsegs gzungs dbang 106/ ༈ byad phur zhi bal/ dgongs gter 107seng gdong mu stegs ma'i dbang*/ them med byad bzlog lha mo lnga'i rang gtad/ ༈ sdig sgrib zhi ba'i skor la/ dgongs gter kun rig dbang*/108 ༈ tshe rgyas pa la/ rno bkra'i tshe dbang bdud rtsi'i gegs sel 109/ (512) ༈ shes rab rgyas pa la/ sgrub thabs dbyangs can ma'i dbang 110/ gu ru zhi ba'i lha mo dbyangs can ma'i gzungs dbang 111/ ༈ bsod nams dang longs spyod rgyas pa la/ rigs lnga'i dzam ser gzungs dbang*/ lha dgu'i dzam lha rigs dgu'i gzungs dbang*/ rno bkra'i rnam sras dmar po'i bka' gtad/ gur drag ku be ra'i bka' gtad/ ro za'i re manta'i bka' gtad 113/ u pa rā dza'i dzam lha dmar po/ rnam thos sras gzungs dbang*/ phag mo'i nor rgyun ma'i gzungs dbang*/ ma ning rnam sras rigs dgu'i dbang 112/ dzam lha dkar/ dmar*/ sngo/ ser/ ljang*/ nag dzaṃ khra bcas las dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/ rnam sras zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang*/ drag po/ a par tsitta bcas las/ dang po/ gnyis pa rnams kyi gzungs dbang*/119 them med ye shes grags/

phyi nang*/ gsang ba/ yang gsang*/ dang po/ gnyis pa'i bka' gtad/ dzaṃ nag bka' gtad/ ༈ lo tog rgyas pa la/ porṇaiya'i(?) sa snying gzungs 115dbang*/ gu ru zhi ba'i klu mi mgon dkar po'i bka' gtad116/ dgongs gter klu dga' bo'i rang gtad117/ ༈ bstan pa rgyas byed la/ sgrub thabs shākya thub pa'i dbang 118/ thub dbang gnas bcu'i dbang rgyas pa119/ dgongs gter byams pa'i gtor 120dbang*/ ༈ bzhi pa dbang gi las la/ lha chen dbang phyug chen po(513)rang gzhung bka' 121gtad/ dgongs gter ma hā de ba'i bka' gtad122/ ༈ lnga pa mngon spyod la/ them med 'dod rgyal gzungs dbang*/ dgongs gter thub pa nag 123po'i dbang*/ mnan pa'i gzer ka 'jigs byed ma hā ba la'i bka' gtad 124/ sreg pa'i gzer ka dgongs gter me lha'i rang 125gtad/ 'phang ba'i gzer dbang phyug zor gyi rang gtad 126/ ༈ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa lung a nu yo ga'i skor la/ khro bo ro za'i rtsa dbang 127/ gzungs dbang 128/ ༈ gsum pa rdzogs chen a ti yo ga la/ rdzogs pa chen po sangs rgyas lag 130bcang gi thugs rje chen po bhu su ku ba'i spros med ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang*/ thod rgal rig pa'i rtsal dbang bcas/ gnyis pa ni/ chos tshan dang po tshe dpag skor/ gnyis pa thugs rje chen po lus dkyil skor/ gsum pa rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i skor/ bzhi pa thugs rje chen po rigs lnga'i skor/ lnga pa thugs rje chen po porṇaiya'i(?).skor/ drug pa thugs rje chen po lha dgu'i skor/ bdun pa thugs rje chen po rno bkra'i skor/ brgyad pa thugs rje chen po sgyibu'i skor/ dgu pa sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i skor/ bcu pa thub pa gnas bcu'i skor/ bcu gcig pa gu ru zhi ba'i skor/ bcu gnyis pa ming gi mngon rdzogs (514) skor/ bcu gsum pa 'jam dbyangs phyag rtags spra ma'i skor/ bcu bzhi pa bde mchog 'khor lo'i skor// bco lnga pa gur drag skor/ bcu drug pa khro bo ro za'i skor/

bcuu bdun pa ye shes 'jigs byed skor/ bco brgyad pa u pa rā dza'i skor/ bcu dgu dpal ldan rgyud kyi bdag po'i skor/ nyi shu pa khyung dmar skor/ nyer gcig pa 'jam dpal na ga ra sha'i skor/ nyer gnyis pa phur mjug skor/ nyer gsum pa rdo rje phag mo'i skor/ nyer bzhi pa sgrol ma'i skor/ nyer lnga pa las hur drag po'i skor/ nyer drug pa dpal mgon ma ning chos skor/ nyer bdun pa 'dzam lha'i skor/ nyer brgyad pa gnod sbyin skor/ nyer dgu pa lha chen dbang phyug chen po'i skor/ sum cu pa gza' bdud hab sha'i skor/ so gcig pa dgongs gter gyi skor/
so gnyis pa them med bka' rgya'i skor bcas so//
